interpretation.causal_limit: Single-task batch2 versus joint4 batch8 changes gradient composition; task-0 exposure (80,000 sample draws), optimizer updates, base/LR recipe, and pooled normalization statistics are matched. This is diagnostic, not a clean causal estimate of multitask interference.
interpretation.decision: Do not expand to 8 tasks. The registered diagnostic target of at least 10/20 paired successes was met, but fixed init3 repeatability was 3/5 rather than 5/5. Continue single-task diagnosis and review the registered four-task gate/matched-exposure design before any later scale decision.
